decision: Extended the real exact-hit proof from unchanged A to edited B and restored A.

decision: Qualified corruption, pre-publication failure, and post-publication failure behavior for the exact source-bundle catalog.
why: Cached bytes must never be trusted blindly, failed work must never be admitted, and the established source-before-Dune publication contract must remain explicit.

result: Failure can replace the macro realm, so one-shot injection uses an external fixture-owned sentinel while the production catalog remains in-memory and treats realm loss as an ordinary cold miss.

decision: Made entry-budget rejection non-fatal and same-key output disagreement fatal.
why: Reuse is optional, so a source bundle above the 64 MiB entry cap must still compile; conversely, one exact semantic key producing different bytes is a correctness violation rather than an ordinary cache miss.
evidence: The candidate index is measured before generated bytes are copied, oversized candidates are reported and skipped, and catalog disagreement quarantines the entry before the request fails.
result: The focused candidate/report fixtures and complete macro-realm plus exact-hit server contract pass; README Goals bars remain unchanged because the route is still opt-in qualification work.

decision: Replace accidental shadow-pass garbage-collection pressure with explicit test-only evaluator compaction in the complete-program server matrix.

The rerun passed with baseline RSS 1640528 KiB, final RSS 657376 KiB, identical clean/server output across the full edit matrix, and no retained private transaction state.

decision: Bind every exact target-reuse request to generic Reflaxe source contents and release catalog leases immediately after copying their bytes.
why: Generic Reflaxe selects and preprocesses the target input and controls output publication, so changing it can change generated source even when reflaxe.ocaml is unchanged. A copied payload no longer needs its catalog entry pinned, and later validation or reporting failures must not prevent reset or eviction.
evidence: Reflaxe e5a9cc0c043fa9434743b6f6e7abc697f827f818 hashes its complete installed source tree into configured target-reuse keys. OcamlCompiler copies the opaque payload, closes the lease on success or failure, then decodes and replays only the detached bytes. The full exact-hit, invalidation, corruption, failure, macro-realm, native-build, formatting, and Dynamic guards pass.
result: The second pass closed both gaps without adding a semantic compiler path. A framework change at the same path is now an exact miss, and no decode, test-hook, replay, or quarantine failure can strand the catalog pin.
